changes.text: Tests: the explorer watcher test survives a slow inotify under wine
Markdown preview: own rendering in theme colors, synced scrolling
Terminal: files dragged from the explorer type their relative paths
Editor: an opened file takes the indentation its text uses
Build: the CI image is pulled, not rebuilt; its base pinned by digest
Git Graph tab: the history of all branches, filters, search, stashes
Status bar: the indentation is chosen with a click, as in VS Code
Explorer: an icon for Nginx configs (nginx.conf, *.nginx, sites-available/...)
Diff tab: the text is highlighted by the file's language, as in the editor
Forgejo in the GitLab view: the branch's Actions run, pull requests, issues
